summary.headline: Jupiter in Five Signs; Mars Begins
summary.text: Astrological judgments for Jupiter appearing in Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius, and Pisces, covering diseases, weather, crops, animals, ships, prices, and social conditions, with repeated observations attributed to Hermes. The text then begins the judgments of Mars appearing in the twelve signs, including the welfare of soldiers, commanders, generals, and fire-workers, and cites Allamah Tusi.
